rule: Music tier is driven by attack state, not aggro. Every 5 s, if any NPC in normal AI with a drawn weapon is in an attack state against the player, or the player is dead, the tier is Fgt (armed) or Thr (unarmed); otherwise Std. Tier is combined with day or night. A theme is looked up by name zone_DAY|NGT_STD|FGT|THR with fallbacks: zone then default zone, day then day, mode then Fgt for Thr, then Std. Transitions: to Std from any other tier plays BREAK; Thr to Fgt plays FILL; Fgt to Thr plays nothing. Cutscene camera: time-keyed Hermite spline per keyframe, exponent 1.005 when the motion type changes between slow and not slow, object-attached cameras skipped, auto-untrigger after last key plus a delay read from the file. Dragon handling: guild GIL_DRAGON (47) is exempt from the early return in the routine reset, so dead dragons are moved to their routine point when the clock is set.
keep: Tier from attack state (an NPC is swinging with a weapon drawn), not from aggro
Break and fill stingers chosen by the from and to tier pair
Zone theme names with a fixed fallback chain so a missing theme still plays
Dead-player tier as the death beat
Cutscene spline with a movable flag and an end delay, client-only
change: Defect: the tier is polled every 5 s, so the change can lag up to 5 s behind the first swing. Fix: push the tier from the server engage and attack-start events on change, no poll
Use the attacker count (1, 2, 3 under MAX_ATTACKERS = 3) as the tier input instead of yes or no
Dragon corpse return: keep as zone data, not an engine exception keyed on a species constant
look_test: One zone, one enemy in the Pit-style arena. Walk up with weapon drawn: calm track, then the enemy swings: break then fight track; note the delay. Put the weapon away while it hunts: threat track. Compare the 5 s poll (donor) with an event-driven change, on phone speaker or headphones.
